title: Closeout summary: Read-only search and status paths can mutate the SQLite FTS index
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

create:false now validates the FTS schema through a genuinely read-only SQLite handle without mkdir or schema initialization; read/list fallbacks no longer rebuild the cache.

Close reason: Read-only opens and queries preserve index size and mtime and never initialize or repair SQLite.
